summary: The Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam has announced Krist Gruijthuijsen as its new director. He will succeed Rein Wolfs, who has led the museum since late 2019. “The Supervisory Board is convinced Krist Gruijthuijsen is the right person to succeed Rein Wolfs,” said board chair Annelies van der Pauw in a statement.

headline: Sydney Announces Basic Income Program For Artists
summary: The city of Sydney has launched its “artist living grants ” program, where 40 artists are given $25,000, about $16,650 USD, no strings attached. The program is based on an income for artists grant that was introduced in Ireland three years ago. Like many metropolitan areas, artists are unable to keep up with the cost of living and move away.

headline: Co-Creation with Machines
summary: Will artificial intelligence replace the artist? Episode 4 of Decoding Art in the Digital Era, co-presented by Art Basel and UBS, explores the evolving relationship between human and machine. From robotics and generative models to questions of datasets, authorship, and originality, Co-Creation with Machines considers AI as a tool, collaborator, source of friction, and system to be pushed toward unexpected outcomes.
